topic: Cesc Fabregas interviewed pitchside by two TNT pundits about how Como beat Man United 4-1
hook: Wide static night-time pitchside shot of three men: two pundits and manager, mics in hand
transition_summary: Single locked-off wide shot; zero cuts; only micro-motion (gestures)
audio_note: Interview dialogue (transcript: 'Cesc, thanks so much for coming out to join us')
